candidates.change_summary: Replace post-conditionless increment with an unchecked addition to allow silent overflow (changes balances update behavior).
Delete the balances update so Deposit no longer increments sender balance (balances unchanged for caller and potentially others).
Change update to write to a different key (zero address) instead of the sender, altering which balance changes after Deposit.
Move the balances increment after logging so that a reentrant Log.AddMessage could observe pre-update state (alters observable balances at end if Log reenters).
Replace arithmetic update with assignment to msg.value (sets balance equal to the deposit rather than adding, changing resulting balances).
